company.shortDescription: Micro Meat is a developed technology that allows cultivated meat producers to scale up their production.
company.description: Micro Meat is a developed technology that allows cultivated meat producers to scale up their production. They provide manufacturing, integration, and consulting services. The company's manufacturers can produce any form of meat or fat using animal-free, sustainable, and plant-based components. Its patent-pending macro carriers are comprised of 3D, biocompatible, and biodegradable materials that are intended to support cell and tissue growth.
